title: vinext: a Vite plugin that completely reimplements the Next.js API surface from scratch
description:
This one dropped today and it's already causing a stir. Cloudflare just open-sourced vinext — a Vite plugin that completely reimplements the Next.js API surface from scratch, so you can run your existing Next.js apps on Vite instead of the Next.js compiler toolchain, and deploy straight to Cloudflare Workers with a single command. Routing, server rendering, React Server Components, all the next module imports — reimplemented, not forked. 

https://github.com/cloudflare/vinext

#github #opensource
